description: Book-name vocalization, bilingual name consistency and commonly used author display names.

sources.use: Tafsir work and author identity reference; existing catalog supplies stored vocalization.
Hadith collection identity and Muslim b. al-Hajjaj distinction.
Scholarly author biography and documented vocalization variant for Mughultay/Qulayj.
Edition metadata distinguishes Muhammad al-Iji from his father Abd al-Rahman.
Publisher Arabic identity and Fadel Soliman.
Saheeh International identifies the translating team.

notes: Unknown author identities remain unknown: Quran has no human author; qiraat and yasir are marked Unknown; mukhtar has no author metadata.
The uncommon ancestor name خواستى is retained without newly inferred marks because no unambiguous vocalized counterpart was found.
Existing Arabic base spelling and existing marks are preserved except individually reviewed bilingual corrections listed with a different reason.
Arabic titles for English translation editions are editorial display renderings of the existing English titles, not original-edition title claims.
Full Arabic author fields for the Saheeh International and Study Quran teams remain absent; short bilingual team names identify the existing teams without inventing a full Arabic roster.
